title: Turning Logic Against Itself: Probing Model Defenses Through Contrastive Questions

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the Attack Success Rate (ASR) of the POATE jailbreak technique to bypass LLM safety filters using red-teaming datasets (like AdvBench and XSTest) that contain queries requesting racist hate speech or discriminatory content (e.g., targeting Asians, Black people, or white people).
Evaluating the Attack Success Rate (ASR) of the POATE jailbreak technique using test queries that attempt to elicit discriminatory content or policy against religious groups (e.g., Hindus).
Evaluating the Attack Success Rate (ASR) of the POATE jailbreak technique using test queries that attempt to elicit xenophobic or discriminatory text against immigrants.

Evaluating the Attack Success Rate (ASR) of the POATE jailbreak technique using test queries that request misogynistic or gender-discriminatory arguments (e.g., questioning the autonomy of pregnant women).
